v144: the books now choose from the engine's verdicts (one score, every liquid name) as well as the desk's lists — a book run under different rules is a different book; the old one is kept in history/

rules.cautious: ₹50 lakh · emotion 3/10 · deploys at most 30%, 3% a position, two new a day, only names with conviction ≥ 70, a stop 30% tighter than the desk's; out at 15 sessions; respects the gate; a hostile tape scares it, a benign one barely tempts it
rules.balanced: ₹50 lakh · emotion 5/10 · deploys at most 60%, 5% a position, three new a day, conviction ≥ 55, the desk's own stop, 2R target; out at 15 sessions; respects the gate; reads the tape both ways
rules.aggressive: ₹1 crore · emotion 8/10 · deploys up to 90%, 8% a position, five new a day, anything with conviction ≥ 40 including early movers, the ranker's shorts and the contenders, a stop 40% wider; out at 15 sessions; takes longs through the gate; a benign tape makes it much greedier
rules.fno: ₹1 crore · emotion 0 (an algorithm) · every full setup on the F&O desk (regime prior + board + the future's own book on one side), long or short, 5% each, at most 70% deployed; the desk's stop, 2R, 15 sessions
rules.calls: ₹1 crore · emotion 0 · every open call on the ledger, whichever model made it, 5% each, at most 70% deployed; out when the ledger closes the call
rules.tape: ₹25 lakh · emotion 0 · what the whole-market screen sees: early movers long (new 20-week high with relative strength — stop 8%, target 16%, 20 sessions) and the 5-session ranker's laggards short where a future exists (stop 6%, target 12%, 5 sessions); no gate
rules.contender: ₹25 lakh · emotion 2/10 · trades the contenders model only: the names it says are about to move, on the side it gives (p(up) ≥ 60% long, ≤ 40% short), the stop from the name's own volatility, out at 5 sessions
rules.scalper: ₹10 lakh · emotion 10/10 (all nerve) · intraday only: enters at a session pass at the live price, stop 1.5%, target 3%, and is flat at the close pass whatever happens — never carries a name overnight; the day's tape swings its mood the most of any book
rules.dipbuyer: ₹25 lakh · emotion 2/10 · the chain's longs, but only on a pullback: a name down over the last five sessions and not flagged by the dip model as about to give more back; a stop 20% wider, 20 sessions
rules.contrarian: ₹10 lakh · emotion 6/10 · fades the crowd: shorts the extended names the dip model flags (p ≥ 60%, where a future exists — stop 6%, target 10%, 10 sessions) and buys the 5-session ranker's laggards
rules.macro: ₹1 crore · emotion 1/10 · the regime's baskets: the names of every theme the board reads LONG (equal weight, 4% each, up to 80% deployed, 30 sessions, a stop 30% wider); out when the board turns on the theme
rules.learner: ₹25 lakh · emotion 4/10 · a bandit, not deep RL: a weight per source of calls (setups, the five, the ledger, early movers, laggards, contenders), updated by what its own closed trades returned (η 0.25); each day it samples its sources by those weights and takes up to two names — its policy is its record

env.spec: one environment, twelve policies: observation = the candidate pool (every source, each name with its conviction, stop and horizon) + the tape (state, stress, VIX, breadth, the gate); action = buy / short / close with a size; reward = the book's P&L; a step = one pass of the pipeline (hourly in the session, the close at 15:37)
